findings.title: "made outside norn" is wrong for a story landed with a merge commit
findings.detail:
A trailer-less commit is labelled `no story (made outside norn)`. Agents' own commits on a story branch carry no Norn-Story trailer (e.g. dfe4813c5 on this branch); when a story lands by merge commit instead of squash, `git log <range> -- <path>` lists those commits (the merge itself is usually simplified away), so the resolver is told they were made outside norn. The spec (D10) assumes squash on main, so this is wording, not a missed criterion.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Say `no story trailer` instead of asserting where it was made, or later look up the merge commit that brought it in.
